verdict.rationale: Knowledge exposes its own programmatic operations: agent tools such as `knowledge_list`, agents writing pages to scopes, and people and agents adding notes. `KNOWLEDGE_ROUTES` powers the Studio Knowledge page, which implies server routes behind the UI. Nothing documents a public API that matches everything the Studio UI does, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: a documented HTTP/SDK API reference for Knowledge, explicit UI–API parity (tree/graph browsing, delete/move between scopes, permission management), an OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: `knowledge_list` lists the pages in a scope.
For updates, the agent writes the page to the scope that matches the request.
People and agents can add notes without rewriting the page.
`KNOWLEDGE_ROUTES` turns on the Knowledge page in Studio, which shows every scope and page as a tree beside a graph of how the pages link.
